  1249→            read_sample_rate: context.read_sample_rate,

  1255→    /// Log block finish event (精简版 - 统计字段通过其他日志文件计算)
  1256→    pub fn log_block_finish(
  1257→        &self,
  1258→        block_id: &str,
  1259→        committed_count: u32,
  1260→        total_duration_us: u64,
  1261→    ) {
  1262→        let event = LogEvent::BlockFinish {
  1263→            timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),
  1264→            thread_list: self.get_participating_threads(),
  1265→            block_id: block_id.to_string(),
  1266→            committed_count,
  1267→            total_duration_us,
  1268→        };
  1269→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Info);
  1270→    }
  1271→
  1272→    /// Log block finish event (legacy version for backward compatibility)
  1273→    pub fn log_block_finish_legacy(
  1274→        &self,
  1275→        block_id: &str,
  1276→        committed_count: u32,
  1277→        total_duration_us: u64,
  1278→        _parallel_tps: f64,
  1279→        _sequential_tps: f64,
  1280→    ) {
  1281→        // Atomic operations no longer needed - statistical fields removed
  1282→
  1283→        // Calculate actual execution duration if not provided
  1284→        let actual_duration_us = if total_duration_us == 0 {
  1285→            if let Ok(start_time_guard) = self.execution_stats.start_time.lock() {
  1286→                if let Some(start_time) = *start_time_guard {
  1287→                    start_time.elapsed().as_micros() as u64
  1288→                } else {
  1289→                    0
  1290→                }
  1291→            } else {
  1292→                total_duration_us
  1293→            }
  1294→        } else {
  1295→            total_duration_us
  1296→        };
  1297→
  1298→        // 统计字段现已删除 - 这些指标将通过原子日志事件计算：
  1299→        // - stall_events_count: 统计scheduler_states.ndjson中StallAdd事件
  1300→        // - waterline_advances_count: 统计scheduler_states.ndjson中WaterlineAdvance事件  
  1301→        // - abort_cycles_count: 统计abort_recovery.ndjson中AbortStart事件
  1302→        // - max_concurrent_executions: 分析TaskPicked/TaskFinished时间重叠
  1303→        // - avg_reexecution_per_tx: 统计IncarnationIncrement事件平均值
  1304→        // - scheduler_efficiency: 基于TaskFinished success/total比率计算
  1305→        // - task_distribution: 统计TaskPicked事件的任务类型分布
  1306→
  1307→        self.log_block_finish(
  1308→            block_id, 
  1309→            committed_count, 
  1310→            actual_duration_us
  1311→        );
  1312→    }

  1479→    // === Helper methods ===
  1480→
  1481→    /// Check if read operations should be sampled
  1482→    pub fn should_sample_read(&self) -> bool {
  1483→        use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
  1484→        static COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
  1485→        
  1486→        let sample_rate = std::env::var("READ_SAMPLE_RATE")
  1487→            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.01".to_string())
  1488→            .parse::<f64>()
  1489→            .unwrap_or(0.01);
  1490→            
  1491→        let count = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
  1492→        (count as f64 * sample_rate) % 1.0 < sample_rate
  1493→    }
  1494→
  1495→    /// Get current timestamp in microseconds since start
  1496→    pub fn current_timestamp_us() -> u64 {
  1497→        use std::sync::OnceLock;
  1498→        static START_TIME: OnceLock<std::time::Instant> = OnceLock::new();
  1499→        
  1500→        let start_time = START_TIME.get_or_init(|| std::time::Instant::now());
  1501→        start_time.elapsed().as_micros() as u64
  1502→    }
  1503→
  1504→    /// Get current thread ID
  1505→    pub fn current_thread_id() -> u64 {
  1506→        use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
  1507→        let thread_id = thread::current().id();
  1508→        let mut hasher = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
  1509→        thread_id.hash(&mut hasher);
  1510→        hasher.finish()
  1511→    }
  1512→
  1513→    /// Flush all writers
  1514→    pub fn flush(&self) {
  1515→        if let Ok(mut writers) = self.writers.lock() {
  1516→            for writer in writers.values_mut() {
  1517→                let _ = writer.flush();
  1518→            }
  1519→        }
  1520→    }

  1746→    /// Legacy method for dependency stall (backward compatibility)
  1747→    pub fn log_dependency_stall(&self, txn_id: TxnIndex, stalled_by: Vec<TxnIndex>) {
  1748→        if let Some(owner_tx) = stalled_by.first() {
  1749→            let event = LogEvent::DependencyBlock {
  1750→                timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),
  1751→                thread_id: Self::current_thread_id(),
  1752→                transaction_id: txn_id,
  1753→                incarnation: 1,
  1754→                state_key: format!("dependency_tx_{}_on_tx_{}", txn_id, *owner_tx),
  1755→                depends_on_tx: *owner_tx,
  1756→                depends_on_incarnation: None,
  1757→            };
  1758→            self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Debug);
  1759→            
  1760→            // Also log as TaskSuspend for suspend analysis
  1761→            self.log_task_suspend(
  1762→                txn_id,
  1763→                1, // Use same incarnation as DependencyBlock
  1764→                "StallPropagation",
  1765→                Some(*owner_tx),
  1766→                None,
  1767→            );
  1768→        }
  1769→    }

  1771→    /// Legacy method for dependency unstall (backward compatibility)
  1772→    pub fn log_dependency_unstall(&self, txn_id: TxnIndex, unstalled_by: TxnIndex) {
  1773→        let event = LogEvent::DependencyResolve {
  1774→            timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),
  1775→            thread_id: Self::current_thread_id(),
  1776→            depender_tx: txn_id,
  1777→            state_key: format!("dependency_resolve_tx_{}_by_tx_{}", txn_id, unstalled_by),
  1778→            on_tx: unstalled_by,
  1779→            resolve_cause: "OnTxExecuted".to_string(),
  1780→        };
  1781→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Debug);
  1782→        
  1783→        // Also log as TaskResume for suspend analysis
  1784→        self.log_task_resume(
  1785→            txn_id,

  1839→    /// Log stall add event (BlockSTMv2)
  1840→    pub fn log_stall_add(
  1841→        &self,
  1842→        txn_id: TxnIndex,
  1843→        incarnation: Incarnation,
  1844→        by_tx: TxnIndex,
  1845→        stall_count_after: u32,
  1846→        first_stall: bool,
  1847→    ) {
  1848→        // Increment stall counter for statistics
  1849→        self.increment_stall_events();
  1850→        
  1851→        // Record stall start time for duration calculation
  1852→        // Only record start time when first_stall is true (transaction becomes stalled)
  1853→        if first_stall {
  1854→            if let Ok(mut stall_times) = self.execution_stats.stall_start_times.lock() {
  1855→                stall_times.insert((txn_id, incarnation), std::time::Instant::now());
  1856→            }
  1857→        }
  1858→        
  1859→        let event = LogEvent::StallAdd {
  1860→            timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),
  1861→            thread_id: Self::current_thread_id(),
  1862→            transaction_id: txn_id,
  1863→            incarnation,
  1864→            by_tx,
  1865→            stall_count_after,
  1866→            first_stall,
  1867→        };
  1868→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Debug);
  1869→    }
  1870→
  1871→    /// Log stall remove event (BlockSTMv2)
  1872→    pub fn log_stall_remove(
  1873→        &self,
  1874→        txn_id: TxnIndex,
  1875→        incarnation: Incarnation,
  1876→        by_tx: TxnIndex,
  1877→        stall_count_after: u32,
  1878→        became_unstalled: bool,
  1879→    ) {
  1880→        // Calculate stall duration only when became_unstalled is true (transaction becomes unstalled)
  1881→        if became_unstalled {
  1882→            if let Ok(mut stall_times) = self.execution_stats.stall_start_times.lock() {
  1883→                // First try exact match (txn_id, incarnation)
  1884→                let mut start_time_opt = stall_times.remove(&(txn_id, incarnation));
  1885→                let mut matched_incarnation = incarnation;
  1886→                
  1887→                // If not found, look for any incarnation of this transaction
  1888→                if start_time_opt.is_none() {
  1889→                    // Find any stall start time for this txn_id with any incarnation
  1890→                    let mut key_to_remove = None;
  1891→                    for &(tid, inc) in stall_times.keys() {
  1892→                        if tid == txn_id {
  1893→                            key_to_remove = Some((tid, inc));
  1894→                            matched_incarnation = inc;
  1895→                            break;
  1896→                        }
  1897→                    }
  1898→                    if let Some(key) = key_to_remove {
  1899→                        start_time_opt = stall_times.remove(&key);
  1900→                    }
  1901→                }
  1902→                
  1903→                if let Some(start_time) = start_time_opt {
  1904→                    let end_time = std::time::Instant::now();
  1905→                    let stall_duration_us = start_time.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;
  1906→                    self.record_stall_time(stall_duration_us);
  1907→                    
  1908→                    // Log stall duration to dedicated file - use the matched incarnation
  1909→                    self.log_stall_duration(txn_id, matched_incarnation, start_time, end_time, stall_duration_us);
  1910→                }
  1911→            }
  1912→        }
  1913→        
  1914→        let event = LogEvent::StallRemove {
  1915→            timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),
  1916→            thread_id: Self::current_thread_id(),
  1917→            transaction_id: txn_id,
  1918→            incarnation,
  1919→            by_tx,
  1920→            stall_count_after,
  1921→            became_unstalled,
  1922→        };
  1923→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Debug);
  1924→    }
  1925→
  1926→    /// Log stall duration with precise timestamps
  1927→    pub fn log_stall_duration(
  1928→        &self,
  1929→        txn_id: TxnIndex,
  1930→        incarnation: Incarnation,
  1931→        start_time: std::time::Instant,
  1932→        end_time: std::time::Instant,
  1933→        duration_us: u64,
  1934→    ) {
  1935→        // Calculate precise timestamps based on current system time
  1936→        let current_system_time = std::time::SystemTime::now();
  1937→        let duration_since_epoch = current_system_time
  1938→            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
  1939→            .unwrap_or_default();
  1940→        let current_timestamp_us = duration_since_epoch.as_micros() as u64;
  1941→        
  1942→        // Calculate start and end timestamps
  1943→        let elapsed_from_start = end_time.duration_since(start_time).as_micros() as u64;
  1944→        let end_timestamp_us = current_timestamp_us;
  1945→        let start_timestamp_us = end_timestamp_us - elapsed_from_start;
  1946→
  1947→        let stall_record = serde_json::json!({
  1948→            "txn_id": txn_id,
  1949→            "incarnation": incarnation,
  1950→            "start_timestamp_us": start_timestamp_us,
  1951→            "end_timestamp_us": end_timestamp_us,
  1952→            "duration_us": duration_us,
  1953→            "thread_id": Self::current_thread_id()
  1954→        });
  1955→
  1956→        // Write directly to stall_duration.ndjson file
  1957→        if let Ok(mut writers) = self.writers.lock() {
  1958→            if let Some(writer) = writers.get_mut(&LogFileType::StallDuration) {
  1959→                if let Ok(json_str) = serde_json::to_string(&stall_record) {
  1960→                    let _ = writeln!(writer, "{}", json_str);
  1961→                    let _ = writer.flush();
  1962→                    // println!("DEBUG: Logged stall duration for txn {} incarnation {} to file", txn_id, incarnation);
  1963→                }
  1964→            } else {
  1965→                println!("DEBUG: StallDuration writer not found in writers map");
  1966→            }
  1967→        } else {
  1968→            println!("DEBUG: Failed to acquire writers lock for stall duration logging");
  1969→        }
  1970→    }

  2171→// === Global logger instance management ===
  2172→
  2173→use std::sync::OnceLock;
  2174→static GLOBAL_LOGGER: OnceLock<Arc<BlockSTMLogger>> = OnceLock::new();
  2175→
  2176→/// Initialize global logger with the given configuration
  2177→pub fn init_global_logger(config: LoggingConfig) -> std::io::Result<()> {
  2178→    let logger = BlockSTMLogger::new(config)?;
  2179→    GLOBAL_LOGGER.set(Arc::new(logger)).map_err(|_| {
  2180→        std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists, "Global logger already initialized")
  2181→    })?;
  2182→    Ok(())
  2183→}
  2184→
  2185→/// Get the global logger instance
  2186→pub fn get_global_logger() -> Option<Arc<BlockSTMLogger>> {
  2187→    GLOBAL_LOGGER.get().cloned()
  2188→}

  2191→
  2192→#[macro_export]
  2193→macro_rules! log_block_start {
  2194→    ($block_id:expr, $dataset:expr, $tx_count:expr, $concurrency_level:expr, $sample_period_ms:expr, $read_sample_rate:expr, $source_csv:expr) => {
  2195→        if let Some(logger) = $crate::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
  2196→            logger.log_block_start($block_id, $dataset, $tx_count, $concurrency_level, $sample_period_ms, $read_sample_rate, $source_csv);
